label: October 12–18, 2026
intro: A free 3-day music festival at centralwOrld this weekend + the Vegetarian Festival's grand finale!
weekday_note: Tuesday English show at Bangkok Planetarium is perfect for school-break weekdays — arrive by 9:45 AM. Also worth checking: Yamaha drum lessons are quieter to book during school break.

activities.title: Melody of Life 17 — Free Live Music Festival
activities.time: From midday each day (check centralwOrld for full schedule)
activities.location: centralwOrld, Pathum Wan (BTS Chit Lom / Siam)
activities.why: 100+ artists across multiple stages over 3 days — free at centralwOrld. Thor gets to experience live music at scale, find his favourite beat, and maybe even a set of live drums to watch up close.
activities.tip: No ticket needed. Go Saturday afternoon for the most stages running simultaneously. Beat the evening rush by arriving at 3 PM. Massive food options in the mall for dinner after.

activities.title: Vegetarian Festival Closing Weekend — Yaowarat
activities.location: Yaowarat Road, Chinatown (MRT Hua Lamphong or Wat Mangkon)
activities.why: Final nights of the festival are the liveliest — closing ceremonies, dragon processions, street food at maximum capacity. If you missed opening week, this is your last shot.
activities.tip: Oct 18 is the absolute last night. Take MRT — parking near Yaowarat is impossible. Arrive at 5 PM for the best atmosphere before it peaks.

activities.title: My First Business: Sweet Potato Edition
activities.price: Check event page for ticket price
activities.why: Thor the entrepreneur — a hands-on kids' workshop about making and selling something. Combines building-and-making with cooking creativity. A fun different angle for a curious 5-year-old.
activities.tip: Check the event link for booking details. Sukhumvit 66 is accessible by BTS Bearing or short Grab from On Nut. Good weekday activity during school break.

activities.title: Bangkok Planetarium — School Break Tuesday Show
activities.location: Science Center for Education, Sukhumvit (near BTS Ekkamai)
activities.price: Museum free / Planetarium ~30–50 THB kids, ~50 THB adults
activities.why: School break means weekday crowds are light and the English show has more space. The 360-degree star dome is always breathtaking for a 5-year-old — Thor will feel like he's flying.
activities.tip: Tuesday only for English shows. Museum opens 8:30 AM — pirate ship and insect halls are Thor-level fun before the dome show.

activities.title: Rollerblading at Roller Dome — School Break Special
activities.price: ฿50/hr or ฿100/day (skate rental + 15 min instruction included)
activities.why: School break is prime time for Roller Dome — more sessions, the rink is buzzing with kids, and Thor can really dig in. Biggest indoor rink in SE Asia means plenty of room to build speed.
activities.tip: If he's been before, challenge him to skate a full lap without the wall. The ฿100 all-day pass is insane value.

activities.title: Kids Cooking Class — A Little Something / Culinary Arts for Kids
activities.location: A Little Something (4 BKK locations) or Culinary Arts for Kids (check current location)
activities.why: Thor the little chef — chopping, mixing, plating, tasting. Building-and-making energy in the kitchen. A Little Something does ages 3–12; Culinary Arts for Kids ages 4–10. Both hands-on, English-friendly.
activities.tip: A Little Something: check alittlesomething.co.th for October workshop schedule. Culinary Arts for Kids: search BKK Kids listing for current sessions. Book early — school break sessions fill fast.

activities.title: Chocolate Ville Spooky Town — Early Halloween
activities.price: Entry fee applies (check Chocolate Ville website)
activities.why: Chocolate Ville transforms into a spooky Halloween village — haunted house decor, costume parades, Ghostbuster show, and all of it family-friendly. Thor will love the theatrical creepiness without it being scary.
activities.tip: This runs all month so no rush — but school break week is a great time to go when you have a free weekday. Evening visits are more atmospheric. Grab from central BKK ~150 THB.
